text: Fixed and verified. The change: in `first_index`, when `sorted_list[mid] == target`, instead of returning immediately, record `result = mid` and continue searching the left half with `hi = mid - 1`. This is the standard "bisect left" pattern — it still examines only O(log n) elements, never modifies the sequence, and returns the leftmost occurrence. `count()` now works correctly too since it scans forward from the true first index.
